questions.subject: Mathematics(10)
questions.question: 10. Out of two identical boxes, the first one contains 5 blue and 4 black balls; the second one contains 4 blue and 8 black balls. One box is selected at random and then one ball is drawn at random from that box. Find the probability that the ball thus drawn is blue. If the ball is blue, then what is the probability that the ball was drawn from the first box?

questions.subject: Physics(10)
questions.question: 1. The maximum run up of a bowler at the computer department end of the Textile Engineering College is 10 m . A student of $2^{\text {nd }}$ year bowls a no ball in every delivery if he starts with a run up greater or less than his run up. If his velocity at the time of throwing the ball is $20 \mathrm{kmhr}^{-1}$ and his acceleration is $120 \mathrm{cms}^{-2}$ then what is the maximum number of overs he can bowl?

questions.subject: Physics(10)
questions.question: 2. A tiger begins to run to catch a deer from $4 \mathrm{~m}$ behind with uniform acceleration $2 \mathrm{~ms}^{-2}$. If the deer moves with uniform velocity $3 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ then when will the tiger catch the deer?
